name: Notice of Nondiscrimination Responsibilities and Reasonable Modifications
description: When informed of a student's pregnancy, the Title IX Coordinator notifies the person of District nondiscrimination responsibilities and offers reasonable modifications.
quote: the Title IX Coordinator shall (1) notify that person of the District’s responsibilities and Board Policy regarding nondiscrimination; and (2) offer reasonable modifications for the student in accordance with the District’s legal obligations.
